text_block_list.text: During training, Oguri Cap looked unwell, so I brought her to the nurse's office...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...'Rest for a few days', huh...
Trying to push through the pain ended up backfiring..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me. I didn't mean to hide it.
I thought I could push through it."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Besides, being unable to run
because of an injury... is the last thing I wanted.
choice_data_list: Don't rush—first, let's just get some good rest.
Then let's get you healed up quickly so we can run again!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're not... going to blame me...?
choice_data_list: Because I know how much you love to run.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list: Then let's focus on getting you healed up for now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I want to run soon, though...
That day, to be on the safe side, I decided to let Oguri Cap rest.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the doctor told you to get plenty of rest.
Hmm, which one of us should I listen to?"

The encouraging words ended up confusing her instead,
and her treatment was prolonged...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Soon... which means we don't have many days.
Understood. I will give it a try.
choice_data_list: Want to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Convincing your mind... the plabowso effect, was it?
A person I met in the forest long ago taught me about it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Heal up now and run, heal up now and run,
I will heal up right now and run...

Her sheer conviction seemed to work wonders...
The very next day, Oguri Cap showed up for training full of energy.
